benchmark_environment.description: Standardized local reproducible testbed running synthetic skewed micro-batches (50,000 orders, 60% assigned to hot merchant_id 'MERCHANT_001').

dataset.skew_pattern: 60% volume allocated to single key (MERCHANT_001), 10% to MERCHANT_002, remaining 30% distributed across 998 merchants

join_skew.metric: SortMergeJoin vs Broadcast Hash Join on 60% skewed fact table
join_skew.mechanism: Elimination of shuffle phase for small dimension table (< 1MB) via broadcast hash join, bypassing straggler task on MERCHANT_001

aggregation_skew.metric: Naive single-stage GroupBy vs Deterministic Two-Stage Salted Aggregation (N=16 salts)
aggregation_skew.mechanism: Salting distributes the 30,000 hot rows across 16 executor tasks during partial aggregation before final group merge

storage_compaction.metric: Fragmented micro-batch writes (15 batches x 4 tasks = 60 tiny files) vs Write-Time Repartitioning + Lakehouse Async Compaction
storage_compaction.mechanism: Metadata file-listing reduction and Parquet column dictionary scanning over consolidated 128MB target blocks
